info.title: Epoch Platform research operations
info.description: Platform owns caller research lifecycle, immutable first-admission interaction policy, idempotency and terminal guidance. Native execution admission, computational contracts and response artifacts belong to Backend. The caller cannot supply interaction policy; only a verified delegated-token claim selects one_shot.

AiTextSkipped.description: Completed computation whose new AI text was omitted without a model call.
AiTextSkipped.title: AiTextSkipped

execution_id.description: Existing/accepted execution this failure refers to; a failed fetch does not change its source status.
execution_id.title: Execution Id

JsonSchema.description: A standard JSON Schema 2020-12 document, including description annotations. The service validates the schema itself. Only local references within this supplied schema are accepted; remote references are rejected. No custom schema keywords are required.

OutputName.description: Unique caller-selected name. Names are case-sensitive.

ResearchResponseContent.description: Answer values or native table references; a preview is never a full table.

qualifications.description: Required computed qualifications; these are not additional answer parts.
qualifications.title: Qualifications

ResearchResponseContent.title: ResearchResponseContent

ResponseQualification.description: Computed answer qualifications, independent of accepted output parts.
ResponseQualification.title: ResponseQualification

RunParameters.description: Only the closed parameter types supported by native Backend execution.
RunParameters.title: RunParameters

parameters.description: Supported native overrides; resolve defaults before freezing the binding.

source_execution_id.description: Resolve the exact study from this authorized Backend execution.
source_execution_id.title: Source Execution Id

SavedOutputManifest.description: A per-execution read receipt. The workflow/Backend owner must save its accepted declarations and exact artifact bindings; this is not another execution coordinator.

execution_id.description: Exact native Backend execution id, never a public admission-attempt id.

SavedOutputManifest.title: SavedOutputManifest

SavedResearchResponse.description: A Backend-owned answer revision. One query can have many named parts.
SavedResearchResponse.title: SavedResearchResponse

TableReference.description: A projection of one immutable execution relation, read in bounded pages.
TableReference.title: TableReference
